summary: This note is a short Wikipedia-style entry on Katy Butler, an American journalist and essayist born in 1949. It identifies her as the author of two books on dying and end-of-life care: Knocking on Heaven's Door (Scribner, 2013) and The Art of Dying Well (Simon & Schuster, 2019).
one_line: Katy Butler is an American journalist, essayist, and author of two books on death and end-of-life care.
key_facts: Katy Butler is an American journalist.
Katy Butler is the author of "Knocking on Heaven's Door, the Path to a Better Way of Death."
"Knocking on Heaven's Door, the Path to a Better Way of Death" was published by Scribner in 2013.
Katy Butler is the author of "The Art of Dying Well: A Practical Guide to a Good End of Life."
"The Art of Dying Well: A Practical Guide to a Good End of Life" was published by Simon & Schuster in 2019.
Both of Katy Butler's books concern death and the end of life.
